external: Keycloak, Istio, gateway, observability and other Kubernetes inference/platform services are configured in other repositories; not covered by this repository-only inventory.
Models, OS packages, Docker engine and unpinned downloaded dependencies have no release pin here and are not represented as version-upgrade candidates.
Local chart versions describe toolkit-owned packaging, not an upstream product version. CI tools and GitHub Actions are tracked separately by Renovate.
